title.narrative: Drilling an artesian well and providing a source of water in the Al-Jadeed area, Al-Mokha District, Taiz Governorate

description.narrative: Contribute to improving water availability and quality in Al-Jadeed village, Al-Mokha district, Taiz governorate, and enhancing sustainability and effectiveness in providing water to the local community

Digging an artesian well 25 meters deep, establishing a solar energy system, operating a submersible pump and all components of the system, leading to an increase in the amount of water available for drinking and domestic use in the project intervention areas, benefiting (2790) beneficiaries for (450) Yemeni families.

Due to the need of the population in Al-Jadeed village in Al-Mokha district, Taiz governorate, for water, and due to the availability of a natural water source (groundwater), this project aims to improve the chances of the population obtaining sufficient quantities of water by drilling an artesian well 25 meters deep and establishing a solar and submersible energy system, in addition to establishing a water distribution point. The project will enable the improvement of water availability and quality in the project intervention areas, and enhance sustainability and effectiveness in providing water to the local community. The project will be implemented over a period of three months, during which all civil works will be carried out to drill an artesian well, establish a solar energy system, and establish a water distribution point.
